title: Rover art pass decisions
intro: Three choices block the **art pass**. Each card says what happened and what each option costs. Pick *I don't know* to accept the stated default.

questions.title: Which look should the rover models use?
questions.background: The rover kit has 14 models. They share one material set, so this choice applies to all of them.
questions.what_happened:
The first render pass mixed two styles:
- the chassis is low poly with flat shading
- the wheels use smooth normals and a PBR texture

options.label: Low poly, flat shading
options.description: Fast to make. About 2 days for all 14 models.

options.label: Smooth PBR
options.description: Closer to the concept art. About 6 days, and the wheel textures need a rework.

questions.idk: We use low poly for the demo and revisit after it ships.

questions.title: Which platforms must the first build run on?
questions.background: Each platform adds a test pass of about half a day.
questions.idk: We ship Windows only and add the others when asked.

questions.title: Should the parts keep their placeholder names?
questions.background: Parts are named `part_01` to `part_40` in the asset tree.
questions.idk: We keep the placeholders until the art pass ends.
